extracted.summary: Nagaland State Merit Scholarship for students from Nagaland pursuing post‑matric studies with a minimum of 70% in the previous qualification.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: For PG 1st year, a minimum of 70% at the Graduation level is required.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be pursuing studies at the post‑matric level in a recognised institution.
extracted.states_quote: Applicants must be a domicile of Nagaland or permanently settled in Nagaland.
